purpose: Name the shared level-entry actor-template records selected by the early scene/level callback block.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_84_LEVEL_ENTRY_SHARED
templates.post_initialize: Callers publish animation roots 0x0012585C, 0x00125864, or 0x0012586C, optionally install movement streams 0x00120FA0, 0x00120F8A, or 0x00120FB4, and place the actor around (0x018E,0x0164) or (0x018E,0x0178).

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_42_LEVEL_ENTRY
templates.post_initialize: The caller places the actor from the active level origin plus (0x0140,0x0100) and the current level offset.

conclusion: Both records are exact 20-byte templates selected by complete level-entry actor bodies. The type-0x84 record is a shared source whose callers provide the movement/animation variants; the type-0x42 record is a one-resource level-entry source.
